6683cd71a1d7ad000866ec6a: At the Battle Pike, Ash must further hone his on-the-spot strategy skills to defeat a soft-spoken, fierce Frontier Brain named Queen Lucy and win his fourth Frontier Symbol.
After arriving on Potpourri Island, our heroes discover the Pokémon Orienteering competition just about to take place and decide to enter, vying for the coveted Pokémon Teamwork medal!
In the Wisteria Town Pokémon Contest, May discovers she is to compete against her old rival Harley.
As our heroes continue toward May’s next Pokémon Contest, Ash’s Grovyle finds itself nursing a crush on Nurse Joy’s Meganium!
After meeting a new Coordinator named Brianna who’s a fan of hers and an even bigger fan of Drew’s, May discovers she must battle her in order to win her third Pokémon Contest ribbon.
After a frustrated Sceptile runs off into the forest, Ash and Pikachu go after it and run into a swarm of angry Beedrill—and the next Frontier Brain!
It’s time for Ash’s next Battle Frontier challenge: a battle in the impressive outdoor arena at the Battle Palace, against Frontier Brain Spenser!
On their way to Ash’s next Battle Frontier challenge, our heroes come across a couple of Pokémon TV stars who aren’t feeling well, so Brock’s Bonsly and James’s Mime Jr. act as stand-ins!
After hearing stories about many Trainers and Pokémon being defeated and taunted by a mysterious talking Pokémon known as Red Lightning, our heroes decide to find out what’s really going on.
When Brock meets up with a lovely Pokémon breeder who used to be a Coordinator, she talks him into competing against May in the Gardenia Pokémon Contest!
On their way to the Battle Tower for Ash’s next challenge, our heroes come across a cute little Smoochum who is fiercely guarded by three Jynx, and Ash has to convince them he’s on their side!
On their way to the Battle Tower, our heroes meet an amazing person who seems to be able to communicate with Pokémon by sensing their feelings…and more surprises await!
After losing to Frontier Brain Anabel, Ash buckles down for some unusual special training—and Anabel joins him! Can he defeat her in the rematch?

After witnessing strange behavior from several kinds of Pokémon on their way to Pewter City, our heroes and Pokémon Ranger Solana encounter an electromagnetic disturbance, which leads them to the discovery of a troubled Deoxys!
After Deoxys flies away with Max and Meowth, our heroes set out to rescue them and discover what’s wrong with the Mythical Pokémon!
On their way to Ash’s final Frontier Battle and Brock’s hometown of Pewter City, our heroes discover a wandering golden Sudowoodo and the estranged Trainer who caused its unusual coloring.
May is going after her fifth Contest Ribbon to qualify for the Grand Festival, but when her shady rival Harley teams up with Team Rocket, things don’t look good!
After a shaky start in the Mulberry Pokémon Contest, May makes it through to the finals, where she goes up against Jessebella—Team Rocket’s Jessie in disguise!
After a squabble causes Jessie and James to part ways, they team up with fellow Team Rocket agents Butch and Cassidy for a Poké Ball-swiping scheme!
Upon arriving in Pewter City, our heroes learn that Brock’s old Gym is being remodeled by none other than Team Rocket in disguise, and Brock and Ash must battle them to put a stop to it!
In the ancient ruins beneath the Battle Pyramid, Ash is mysteriously possessed by the spirit of an ancient and evil king, who challenges Frontier Brain Brandon to a battle for all of his Pokémon.
On their way to the Grand Festival, our heroes help a berry farmer reclaim his stolen crop.
As the Grand Festival gets under way at the Indigo Plateau, May has her hands full trying to compete with the best Coordinators in the world, including Harley, Drew, and new friend Solidad!
The Grand Festival is going strong as May faces down one impressive competitor after another!
May faces Drew in the quarterfinals of the Grand Festival, and the two seem to be very evenly matched! Can May come out ahead?

On their way to Ash’s rematch with Brandon at the Battle Pyramid in Fennel Valley, our heroes come across a village taking part in the annual ritual of choosing a king, and Ash’s Aipom becomes a most unwilling candidate!
Our heroes meet an aspiring comedian named Audrey and her showbiz sidekick and Pokémon partner, Chatot.
Our heroes find themselves embroiled in Pokémon politics as two Weavile face off for leadership of a group of Sneasel!
When our heroes arrive at the Battle Pyramid for Ash’s battle with Brandon, they discover a Nurse Joy who’s a big fan of Ash and May!
After their recent defeats in important matches at the Battle Pyramid and the Grand Festival, Ash and May are feeling a little down, until several old friends come together to support them.
When Nurse Joy becomes too ill to take care of the Pokémon Center, our heroes pitch in, coming to the aid of a Pokésitter and his charges after a bus accident.
Ash prepares for his final rematch with Brandon at the Battle Pyramid by rounding up the Pokémon he’s been with the longest, spending his time sharing old memories with them and training intensely.
Ash has lost to Brandon in two previous battles, and now his Charizard has been defeated! Can he battle back to claim the final Frontier Symbol?
Ash has beaten the Battle Frontier, but his competitive spirit won’t let him rest for long, and he and May both sign up for an unofficial Pokémon Contest in Terracotta Town!
After one last contest battle between Ash and May, our heroes go their separate ways, and Ash discovers his next adventure!

Ash Ketchum, a 10-year-old from Pallet Town, is finally old enough to receive his first Pokémon! However, he oversleeps, and the only remaining Pokémon at Professor Oak’s lab is a strong-willed Pikachu!
Ash rushes into Viridian City with his wounded Pikachu, where he encounters Jessie, James, and Meowth of Team Rocket, as well as Misty, who’s angry about Ash wrecking her bike!
Ash discovers and catches his first Pokémon! Though he’s excited, Misty is grossed out by his new Bug-type Pokémon friend.
An angry swarm of Beedrill attacks Ash and Samurai in the midst of a Metapod standoff! Ash flees, leaving behind his Metapod, who is mad at him for abandoning it.

Ash challenges the Pewter City Gym Leader, Brock, but even Pikachu has no chance against Brock’s Rock-type Pokémon. With the mysterious Flint helping him, it’s time for Ash to train hard before the rematch!

O irmão rico de Chris vem para Chicago e se apropria da vida de Chris, incluindo seu negócio, o Rigby's. Chris se nega a trabalhar para seu irmão e viver com ele em sua casa.
É o Primeiro de abril e Kenan e Kel brincam e fazem pegadinhas com todos. No entanto, as coisas começam a complicar as piadas fazem todos serem presos.
Nesse episódio especial, Kenan e Kel se reúnem para ver algumas gravações que relembram os momentos mais divertidos da série nesses quatros anos que se passaram.
Os Rockmore decidem fazer uma viagem em família e Kel se esconde no carro para ir junto com eles. Enquanto passam a primeira noite em um acampamento, Kenan tem um encontro com um ser misterioso.
Quando o carro da família estraga, Kenan e Kel saem em busca de ajuda e acabam sendo convidados para jantar na mansão de um homem desconhecido.
Quando um dos convidados desaparece, Kenan e Kel suspeitam que seus misteriosos anfitriões estão, de alguma maneira, envolvidos nisso.
Kenan quer comprar um carro. Com a ajuda de seu amigo Kel, Kenan consegue comprar um carro bastante econômico, até descobrir que se trata de um carro roubado!
Kenan resolve processar uma empresa de peixes depois de quase se afogar com um parafuso que estava dentro de sua lata de atum.
Kenan lê um livro do autor Ernest Hemingway que o inspira a criar uma lista de metas para ter uma vida mais completa. Enquanto isso, Kel também tenta estabelecer as suas próprias metas.
Quando de repente Kel parece ter poderes paranormais, Kenan conduz seu amigo ao "caminho da fama", o escrevendo para participar de um show ao vivo para demonstrar estes poderes.
Kenan e Kel são barrados ao tentar entrar em uma boate, então Kenan se sente inspirado a criar a sua própria boate - no Rigby's!
Kenan consegue um encontro com sua amada Brianna, mas o momento é seguido por várias desventuras e eventos infelizes.
Kenan e Kel ficam chocados quando se deparam com um retrato falado de Roger, pai de Kenan, sendo procurado por roubar milhões de dólares em diamantes.
Para combater a gripe de Kel, Kenan acidentalmente descobre a cura para a gripe usando uma combinação de galinha, ovos, sardinha e refrigerante de laranja.
Kenan salva o presidente dos Estados Unidos de ser ferido por uma torre de latinhas de refrigerante de laranja e é convidado para visitar à Casa Branca.
Kenan chama uma garota para sair, que é exatamente a filha do chefe de seu pai. Mas no processo, deixa uma escandalosa mensagem na secretária eletrônica da família da garota.
Kenan guardou dinheiro o suficiente para comprar uma nova bicicleta bem em tempo do Natal. Mas será que ele gastará todo esse dinheiro com um presente para ele mesmo?
Chega a competição anual de empacotadores, na qual Chris sempre perde. Kenan e Kel praticam, e um rival, Angus, contrata Kel para competir por ele contra a equipe do Rigby’s.
Durante a limpeza de primavera no porão da Rigby's, Kenan e Kel acham um mapa para alguma coisa secreta. Kenan diz que é um mapa para um cofre, mas Kel acredita ser um mapa para um sofá.
A preciosa cacatua de Roger é deixada sob os cuidados de Kenan e Kel quando seus pais saem de viagem, mas o pássaro acaba morrendo. Kenan e Kel precisam fazer de tudo para conseguir uma nova cacatua.
Kenan entra em pânico quando a diretora de sua escola liga para sua casa para chamar seus pais à escola. Nervoso, ele contrata dois completos estranhos para se passar por seus pais.
